### PYQ_01: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding epithelial tissue?

- A) Cells are compactly packed with little intercellular matrix
- B) It is avascular in nature
- C) Free surface faces either a body fluid or the outside environment
- D) It contains abundant collagen white fibre bundles

> **✅ Answer:** D) It contains abundant collagen white fibre bundles
> **Explanation:** Epithelial tissue contains NO fibres in its matrix; collagen white fibres belong to connective tissue.

### PYQ_02: Cuboidal epithelium with brush border of microvilli is found in:

- A) Lining of intestine
- B) Duct of salivary glands
- C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
- D) Eustachian tube

> **✅ Answer:** C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
> **Explanation:** PCT of nephron has simple cuboidal brush-bordered epithelium for maximum selective reabsorption.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Cuboidal epithelium with brush border of" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PYQ_03: Select the CORRECTLY matched pair:

- A) Tendon — Specialised connective tissue
- B) Adipose tissue — Dense connective tissue
- C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
- D) Cartilage — Loose connective tissue

> **✅ Answer:** C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
> **Explanation:** Areolar and Adipose are Loose Connective Tissues; Tendon is Dense Regular CT; Cartilage is Supportive CT.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Select the CORRECTLY matched pair:" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PYQ_04: The ciliated columnar epithelial cells in humans are known to occur in:

- A) Eustachian tube and stomach lining
- B) Bronchioles and Fallopian tubes
- C) Bile duct and oesophagus
- D) Fallopian tubes and urethra

> **✅ Answer:** B) Bronchioles and Fallopian tubes
> **Explanation:** Ciliated columnar epithelium moves mucus in bronchioles and ova in Fallopian tubes.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="The ciliated columnar epithelial cells i" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PYQ_05: The function of the gap junction is to:

- A) Perform cementing to keep neighbouring cells together
- B) Facilitate communication between adjoining cells by connecting cytoplasm
- C) Stop substances from leaking across tissue
- D) Anchor cell to basement membrane

> **✅ Answer:** B) Facilitate communication between adjoining cells by connecting cytoplasm
> **Explanation:** Gap junctions allow rapid transfer of ions, small molecules, and signals between cells.
